name: Scotiabank Platinum American Express Card

apr.notes: 9.99% on purchases and on cash advances, balance transfers and cash-like transactions.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees; only the exchange rate applies.

credit_required.notes: Minimum personal income of $12,000 per year.

base_rate.description: 2 Scene+ points per $1 on eligible purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Scene+ points redeem for travel, groceries, dining, entertainment, gift cards and statement credits against purchases.

signup_bonus.description: 60,000 bonus Scene+ points after $5,000 in everyday eligible purchases in the first 3 months.

notes: Scotiabank American Express cards carry no network package tier, so network_tier is none.
